_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_combat_damage_to_planeswalker.py. t_cdpw_saboteur prints both halves of "deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker" as two triggered abilities claiming one line; t_cdpw_player_only prints the player half alone, which is the control that proves a planeswalker hit does not quietly fire every saboteur in the pool. t_cdpw_bystander carries the planeswalker trigger too so `source: self` can be shown to scope it to the creature that connected.
